data.exact_reserve_text:
The prior accident year experience has been less benign. Deterioration on the earned and booked position on some accounts has had a negative impact on the host Syndicate's result for the year. In particular, deterioration on certain Marine Insurance segments has dragged back the performance of this class. Corrective action has now been applied to this account to restructure its composition and return it to the profitable performance it has historically produced.
The legacy Solicitor's Professional Indemnity portfolio, from which the host Syndicate has now exited, also exhibited some deterioration in the first half of the calendar year based on claims development on prior year exposures. Recent development has been more stable, but reserves have nonetheless been strengthened.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Back year adjustment in 2014 in respect of the 2008 to 2013 underwriting years where Barbican Syndicate 1955 ceded 11.5% of its book on those years retrospectively to the Syndicate.

named_events.loss_description: Notable large loss in a class in which the host Syndicate operates (mentioned alongside Tianjin).

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding were GBP 48.622m at 1 January 2015. The syndicate's gross claims development triangle shows no material net prior-year reserve movement for underwriting years up to and including 2013 (net prior-year development ~ GBP 0.0m). The managing agent's narrative describes deterioration on certain prior accident year accounts (notably Marine Insurance segments) and some strengthening of reserves on a legacy Solicitor's PI portfolio; large man-made losses in the period (Pemex and Tianjin) are highlighted as drivers of volatility but outwards reinsurance limited their net impact. A prior-year back-book cession (2014) of 2008-2013 underwriting years to SPS was a material adjustment in the prior year.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (liabilities: claims outstanding). No explicit single-line 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross figure was found; gross claims development triangle (note 13) was used to assess prior year development and shows effectively zero net movement for underwriting years <=2013. Narrative describes some prior-year deterioration and selective reserve strengthening (legacy Solicitor's PI) which appears to be granular rather than changing the aggregate gross prior-year position. Some table parsing ambiguity exists in the printed triangle layout; triangle values were interpreted conservatively. LOB movement amounts were not quantified in the report and have been inferred qualitatively where commentary existed.
